problem: Long QR-2 report ranges were refused whole when the bar-coverage check would exceed a coverage budget: Month (the default period) from about day 16, Year and All Time for Bots older than about 15 to 30 days. Staging answers 503; the local fix F answers 422.
change: Over a degradable coverage budget the report still returns; bar coverage for the whole request is UNAVAILABLE with reason COVERAGE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED (panel class C7, English and Thai). Degradable: union_minutes (plan time) and the data-time stops of timestamp_rows, derivation_visits, output_intervals and coverage_output_bytes. Not degradable (unchanged 422 or 503): unique_windows, coverage_input_bytes, plan-time byte refusals, unnamed overflow, the post-build lowered-limit refusal and every financial limit. The worker accepts a data-time claim only when the planned windows make it possible (feasibility check). No budget value, financial number or status changes. Cache tokens qr2o8 to qr2o9 for i18n.js and paper-performance.js; the 422 hint keeps only its generic text.
